key_catalyst: Alphabet/Tesla Q2 AI-capex selloff broadening into a heavy Mag-7 earnings week (Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple)
reasoning: The dominant driver is the mega-cap AI-capex earnings selloff: Alphabet (-7%) and Tesla (-14.5%) drove a $797B single-day Mag-7 loss, the worst since the April 2025 tariff tantrum, and the capex-vs-profitability debate remains unresolved with Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Apple all reporting this week. The July 27 +1.64% bounce was an anticipatory pre-earnings rally, not absorption of results, and it coincides with a July 29 FOMC decision where rate-hike odds have risen sharply — leaving two live, escalating downside drivers into the session.
